cohort: The study included 80 women diagnosed with placenta accreta spectrum (PAS), either antenatally or intraoperatively, at a tertiary care obstetric hospital in Srinagar, India, over two years.
finding: The incidence of PAS was 2.227 per 1,000 live births, with a high rate of antenatal diagnosis (87.5%) and significant maternal morbidity, including caesarean hysterectomy in 66.25% and blood transfusions in nearly 99% of cases.
mod_finding: Elective delivery occurred in 67.5% of women, while 31.25% required an emergency caesarean section; caesarean hysterectomy was required in 66.25% of cases.
